result.reason: The redline adds a clear professional-and-workmanlike performance warranty and an applicable-law compliance obligation, but omits the documentation-conformity warranty, all required warranty periods, the repair/replace/refund remedy, and the malicious-code warranty. It therefore reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. The amendment remains compatible with Section 13.5 because that disclaimer preserves warranties expressly stated in Article XIII. It is not minimal for playbook purposes because it adds extra qualified-personnel and industry-standard requirements while still failing to add the language necessary to achieve either complete position; it also inconsistently uses “Applicable Law” where the original text uses “Applicable Laws.”
